name: John Murdock
dateNote: He was baptized on 5 November 1830; section 99 calls him on a mission in August 1832.
importance: Section 52 sends him to Missouri with Hyrum Smith by way of Detroit in June 1831. He fell ill on the way and stayed at Chariton, where Joseph Smith met him (62). Section 99 calls him to preach in the eastern countries after providing for his children.
connections: His wife Julia Clapp died in 1831 after giving birth to twins, whom Joseph and Emma Smith adopted. Hyrum Smith was his companion in sections 52 and 62.

sources.title: John Murdock, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: JSP: born 15 July 1792, Kortright, New York; baptized by Parley P. Pratt 5 Nov. 1830; wife Julia died 30 Apr. 1831; twins adopted by Joseph and Emma Smith; Zion high council 1834; later in Utah; death shown as a fragment (23 Dec. 1871, Beaver, Utah).
